_comment: Approvals for the member Production project (splitpost-members-production). Each changes only by a reviewed PR (the founder's approval). photosApproved and postMediaFunctionApproved are true for founder-only photo posting (docs/PHOTOS.md, member Production); invitationsApproved stays false. photosApproved: whether photo posting may be switched on there (ops.media_settings.photos_enabled). invitationsApproved: whether accounts other than the launch founder may be given membership (ops.member_launch_settings.external_access_approved) or invited (ops.invitations). Setting a flag to true does not change the database: it only allows a separately approved, recorded change. While a flag is false, supabase/tests-members/001_member_production.sql fails if the database shows the feature on, and every member workflow stops. postMediaFunctionApproved: whether the post-media Edge Function may be deployed to member Production (the avatar function is the default and only one until then); it allows the deploy only, and photo posting still needs photosApproved. waitlistBridgeFunctionApproved (BL-009): whether the waitlist-bridge Edge Function may be deployed to member Production; it allows the deploy only, and nothing can be sent while invitationsApproved and external access stay closed.
